prose: DietPi v10.8 was released, announced on Hacker News. The lightweight Debian-based distribution adds a WireGuard management tool, name-based software installation, an optimized HAProxy package, CD/DVD/Blu-ray drive support on Quartz64, ARM and UEFI support for UTM virtual machines, and fixes across its drive manager, cloudshell, and several self-hosted apps including Immich's machine learning component.
highlights: DietPi v10.8: new WireGuard server/client management tool
Software installed by name instead of numeric IDs
UTM VMs gain ARM and UEFI support
Marginal AI relevance; surfaced via the HN feed
